name: company
sql: CREATE TABLE company (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,name text NOT NULL,age INTEGER NOT NULL,address char(50),salary real)

name: increase_salary_after_employee_termination
sql: CREATE TRIGGER increase_salary_after_employee_termination AFTER DELETE ON company BEGIN UPDATE company SET salary = salary + 100;END

name: cheapest_employee
sql: CREATE VIEW cheapest_employee AS SELECT id, name FROM company WHERE salary = (SELECT MIN(salary) FROM company) LIMIT 1
